papers.summary_zh: 團隊科學指出領導力是應變的：只在特定條件下有幫助，而能力強且自主的團隊可能完全不需要領導。本文針對多 Agent LLM 團隊提出類似問題：在何種可量測條件下，流程層級的協調控制能增加價值？這些條件是否與團隊科學的預測一致？作者使用行為特徵（多數鎖定、探索、從錯誤的第0回合共識中恢復）以及逐動作消融實驗，乾淨地分離每個控制維度的影響。研究發現存在一個「恢復優勢邊界」，在此邊界內領導能顯著提升團隊表現，超出此邊界則可能無效甚至有害。

links.title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents

primary_link.title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents

papers.summary: Production LLM agents increasingly depend on real-time search, yet native search grounding bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency, and generation behavior behind a single model-provider boundary. This coupling makes grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse, or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. We present Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic boundary that moves grounding outside the reasoning mode
papers.summary_zh: 生產環境中的 LLM Agent 越來越依賴即時搜尋，但原生搜尋接地將檢索策略、供應商選擇、證據注入、成本、延遲與生成行為捆綁在單一模型供應商邊界內，導致接地難以檢查、調整、重用或移植，並可能引發搜尋誘導的冗長回應。本文提出解耦搜尋接地，一個供應商無關的邊界，將接地從推理模型外部移至獨立模組。此架構使接地邏輯可插拔、可測試且與生成分離，在保持回應品質的同時降低成本和延遲，並允許靈活切換後端搜尋服務。
papers.title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 將搜尋與推理解耦：LLM Agent 的供應商無關接地架構

links.title: A Variational Framework for LLM Generator-Regulator Games

primary_link.title: A Variational Framework for LLM Generator-Regulator Games

papers.summary: This paper develops a variational framework for regulated language generation. Starting from autoregressive token sampling, we derive the induced distribution over complete messages and relate it to an entropy-regularized Gibbs law. Regulation is modeled as an optimal discriminator whose convex-dual value is an f-divergence, and the generator-regulator interaction is formulated as a saddle-point problem. The framework applies to moderation, censorship, AI deception detection, compliance auditing
papers.summary_zh: 本文發展了一個用於受調節語言生成的變分框架。從自迴歸標記取樣出發，推導出完整訊息上的誘導分佈，並將其與熵正則化的 Gibbs 定律相關聯。調節被建模為一個最優判別器，其對偶值為 f-散度，生成器與調節器的互動被表述為一個鞍點問題。該框架可應用於內容審核、審查、AI 欺騙檢測、合規審計與安全對齊等場景，為理解和設計受控語言生成提供了統一的理論基礎。
papers.title: A Variational Framework for LLM Generator-Regulator Games

However, no UDLM has yet been pretrained from scratch at both large parameter scale and large token budget. Both autoregressive modeling and masked diffusion modeling already have capable models at scale that the community can study and build on; uniform diffusion has none. A scratch-pretrained UDLM at scale would provide a clean reference point for studying scaling behavior, generation dynamics, controllability, and trade-offs against established autoregressive and masked diffusion models. To this end, we introduce Sumi ("ink" in Japanese), a fully open 7B uniform diffusion language model pretrained from scratch on 1.5T tokens. Sumi performs competitively with autoregressive models trained at comparable token budgets on knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks, while under-performing on commonsense benchmarks, where our education-heavy data mixture is a likely contributor. We release our model weights, checkpoints, and full training recipe, including a complete specification of the data mixture over publicly available corpora. We hope this release enables the community to study native uniform diffusion at scale and catalyzes work on its as-yet poorly understood aspects.
